title: Huntington’s disease biomarker progression profile identified by transcriptome sequencing in peripheral blood
description: In this study we investigated the suitability of blood to identify HD transcriptomic biomarkers, validated the outcome in an independent cohort and derived a first empiric panel of biomarkers capable of predicting HD motor scores. Finally we examined whether patient gene expression profiles could provide information about HD affected biological pathways. Overall design: Examination of differentially expressed genes in peripheral whole blood using linear modelling of gene expression data (3' DGE) against UHDRS total motor scores of Huntington's Disease mutation carriers and controls.
